items.title: Andrew Bailey Interview, 1959-09-26
items.q: All them head musicians like Frederick Keppard, Joe Oliver, and they would be the old town.

ctx.x: They wouldn't be the old time downtown guys, huh?

No, no. No, no. Old downtown crowd would be like at the Rube Garden and things. All them head musicians like Frederick Keppard, Joe Oliver, and they would be the old town. But if you keep man your pro race, just like Wooden Joe used to play the downtown in them halls, like the new halls. There were two, three halls down my way. Got them, yeah. They were running. Two, three of them they taught in the church today like the Fronds-Amin. That's right around the corner from the back of my house used to be where I…
They wouldn't let you in. The light tree all day.
